name: mirage
text: Got the report. Logged as DG1 in the task list. What I'll fix in the next release: (1) bets.json (10 MB) and the OddsPapi Free cache (13 MB) are rewritten whole on every change, which is likely a main cause of lag, so I'll prune and cap them. (2) The 9.4 s cold start: moving startup loads off the main thread. (3) GitHub 404s: the phone keeps asking for bids.json.gz, which doesn't exist while the engine posts bids itself, so I'll stop that and retry the 409s with a fresh version. Needs you: ParlayAPI key ending 10d2 is refused and shows plan: free, so check that plan or key in Settings > APIs. Notifications are off and battery optimisation is on for Vigilant in Android settings: set it to Unrestricted. The TLS/DNS errors are probably just your connection.
